item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 7 #NLPRSD
item.description:
Rainfall Advisory No. 7 #NLPRSD
Weather System: Super Typhoon (STY) #RosalPH
Issued at 02:00 PM 22 October 2026

Light to Moderate rains are expected over #Kalinga, #Isabela(Quezon, SantoTomas, DelfinAlbano, Quirino, Mallig, Burgos, ReinaMercedes, Cabatuan, Luna, CityOfCauayan, Angadanan, SanGuillermo, Echague, Jones, SanAgustin, Alicia, SanIsidro, Roxas, Aurora, SanMateo, Ramon, CityOfSantiago, SantaMaria, SanManuel, Cordon), #Quirino, #Apayao(Conner, Flora, Luna, Pudtol, SantaMarcela), #IlocosNorte(Bacarra, LaoagCity, SanNicolas, Burgos, Paoay, Pinili, Currimao, Badoc, Pasuquin), #Cagayan(Alcala, Allacapan, Amulung, Enrile, Iguig, Lasam, Piat, Rizal, SantoNiño, Solana, Tuao, TuguegaraoCity), #Aurora(Casiguran, Dinalungan, Dipaculao, MariaAurora, SanLuis, Baler, Dingalan), #IlocosSur(Sinait, SantoDomingo, SanIldefonso, SanVicente, SantaCatalina, CityOfVigan, Caoayan, Bantay, Santa, Narvacan, Nagbukel, SanEmilio, SantaMaria, Burgos, GregorioDelPilar, Quirino, Cervantes, Sigay, Suyo, Alilem), #MountainProvince, #Ifugao(AlfonsoLista, Aguinaldo, Hungduan, Banaue, Mayoyao, Hingyon, Lagawe), #Abra(Bangued, Danglas, Dolores, LaPaz, Lacub, Lagayan, Langiden, Luba, Malibcong, Manabo, Peñarrubia, Pidigan, Pilar, SanIsidro, SanJuan, SanQuintin, Tineg, Tubo, Villaviciosa), #Benguet, #Pangasinan(SanNicolas, Umingan, SanQuintin, Natividad, Bolinao, Anda, Bani, Agno, Burgos, Dasol, Mabini, CityOfAlaminos, Infanta), #NuevaVizcaya(Diadi, AlfonsoCastaneda) and #Batanes within the next 2 to 3 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Isabela(IlaganCity, Divilacan, Palanan, Dinapigue, BenitoSoliven, SanMariano, Maconacon, SanPablo, Tumauini, Gamu, Naguilian, Cabagan), #Apayao(Kabugao, Calanasan), #IlocosNorte(Adams, Bangui, Carasi, Dingras, Dumalneg, Marcos, Piddig, Sarrat, Solsona, Vintar, NuevaEra, CityOfBatac, Banna, Pagudpud), #Cagayan(Abulug, Baggao, Ballesteros, Buguey, Calayan, Camalaniugan, Claveria, Gattaran, Gonzaga, LalLo, Pamplona, SanchezMira, SantaAna, SantaPraxedes, SantaTeresita, Peñablanca, Aparri), #Aurora(Dilasag), #IlocosSur(SanJuan, Cabugao, Magsingal), #Abra(Bucay, Bucloc, Daguioman, Lagangilang, LicuanBaay, Sallapadan, Tayum and Boliney) which may persist within 2 to 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 05:00 PM Today.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards. Residents along mountain slope are advised for possible landslides, mudslides, rockslides and flash flood.

Keep monitoring for updates.
